title: Successive partial sums of a list
statement: Let $M$ be an additive monoid, let $l$ be a list of elements of $M$, and let $j$ be a natural number. The sum of the first $j+1$ terms of $l$ equals the sum of its first $j$ terms plus the term at position $j$, taking that term to be $0$ when the list has no such position.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list with entries in $M$
